title: Evaluation of TNF Alpha Production by LPS Stimulated PBMCs Treated with Peptides
author: Lily Johanna Toro
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kdkcs4w
materials: Cultivar en una caja de cultivo celular de 96 pozos 250.000cel/pozo a un volumen final de 100 µL/pozo en RPMI 1640 suplementado con antibiótico antimicótico (ampicilina/estreptomicina) 1X . Dejar incubando por 12 horas, hasta que las células se estabilicen. Antibiotic-Antimycotic (100X) Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15240062 RPMI 1640 Medium Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11875093 5 Plates Well-Coated™ Biotin, 96 well plate, White G-Biosciences Catalog #786-763 12:00:00

Realizar diluciones de proteína, péptido o compuesto a evaluar. Calculando un volumen de 10 µL por pozo de la proteína/péptido a evaluar a una concentración 10X con respecto a la concentración final en el pozo. Preparar la solución de trabajo de Lipopolisacarido (LPS) a 10X (100ng/mL). Preparación de las alícuotas de LPS (según el inserto del LPS O26:B6). Stock 1: tomar 1mg de LPS y re-suspenderlo en 1mL de Sln salina estéril (repartir en 10 tubos con alicuotas de 100µL). (Queda a una concentración de 1mg/mL) Stock 2: tomar un tubo del stock 1 y sacar 1µL en un tubo nuevo y aforar hasta 1mL (repartir en 10 tubos con alicuotas de 100µL). (Queda a una concentración de 0,001mg/mL=1µg/mL) Sln de trabajo 10X: A partir de un tubo del stock 2, tomar 1µL por pozo (100µL de volumen final) y lleve a 10µL para concentración de 100ng/mL o 10X. Marque tubos de 1,5mL correspondientes a cada control y tratamiento. Mezcle las soluciones de muestra, control y LPS en tubos de 1,5mL. ((10µL LPS 10X + 10µL tratamiento o control 10X +80µL medio de cultivo)/pozo) Mezclar por vortex 1 min y dejar incubar los tratamientos a 37ºC por 30 minutos. Lipopolysaccharides from Escherichia coli O26:B6 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #L2654 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes Contributed by users 00:30:00

steps.title: Prepare treatment tubes
steps.instruction: Label and set up 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes for each experimental condition.

steps.title: Collect and clarify supernatants
steps.instruction: Harvest the supernatant from each tube, centrifuge at 9000 g for 2 min, then transfer the clarified supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: ELISA timing and storage
steps.instruction: Run the Human TNF‑α ELISA (BioLegend Cat# 430204) immediately; if storage is required, keep supernatants at –80 °C (avoid thawing) and never store at –30 °C.

steps.title: Assess viability with resazurin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of resazurin (Acros Organics Cat# 189900050) to each well to reach a final concentration of 44 µM, incubate the plate for 2 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then read absorbance at 570 nm and 450 nm (or fluorescence ex/em 579/584 nm).

steps.title: Prepare working medium and sensitize plate
steps.instruction: Make a 1X culture medium working solution (final 440 µM) and use it to sensitize the ELISA plate one day before the assay.

steps.title: Add treatments and incubate PBMCs
steps.instruction: Tilt the PBMC plate 45° and slowly remove existing supernatant. Add 100 µL per well of each treatment in the order: (1) culture medium, (2) samples without LPS, (3) samples with LPS, using a fresh tip for each addition and avoiding cross‑contamination. Incubate 12 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Plate reading and data analysis
steps.instruction: Measure each well at 570 nm and 450 nm. Define blanks as wells containing only cells and medium; calculate the median blank value and subtract it from all wells. Compute delta = 450 nm – 570 nm. Generate a standard curve (X = concentration, Y = delta) using the kit’s standards and the equation Y = (A‑D)/(1+(X/C)^B)+D. Apply the curve to obtain sample concentrations (pg/mL) and plot treatment versus TNF‑α concentration.
